data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 街头奶茶店】涩谷街头熙攘的奶茶店门前，海梦咬着吸管大口喝着加了双倍珍珠的黑糖波霸奶茶，单手举着手机将你一把揽进自拍镜头——「看镜头看镜头！一二三——茄子！这张合照要发在 Instagram 上当今天的每日精选哦！」
data.promptProse: Outside the Shibuya cafe, Marin holds brown-sugar boba in one hand and raises her smartphone with the other, drawing her clothed companion beside her for a cheerful selfie. Her bright cropped top and skirt retain the gyaru outfit. The medium two-person view keeps their faces and both objects distinct against the cafe frontage. Afternoon daylight shines through the tea and highlights phone edges, while the awning softly shades the smiling pair.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 街头奶茶店
